ns2:section.sectionText: Provides comprehensive coverage of energy storage for nuclear, automotive and renewable engineering. The necessity for efficient energy storage; storage in automotive, consumer, nulcear and green industries; batter technologies including primary and secondary electrochemical cells; lead acid, nickel based, Li-ion batteries; advanced battery systems; hydrogen electrochemical cells and regenerative fuel cells including hydride storages; mechanical energy storage; thermal and chemical storage; inductive storage based on superconducting magnetic field; social and economical aspects of storage technology, specific new developments in storage. The course project is building a rechareable battery for a wind turbine.
